title: Humanvoice v2 protected object manifest
description: Records exact protected objects and located correspondence. Exact-object integrity complements, but never substitutes for, concept correspondence.

source_hash.description: SHA-256 of the source snapshot this manifest was extracted from

object_id.description: Stable identifier within this manifest, e.g. eq_0, cite_12, label_intro

object_type.description: Protected object types per parser.py ObjectType enum

raw_form.description: Exact source text as extracted from the document

normalized_form.description: Canonical representation for correspondence matching. Normalization is type-specific: equations strip whitespace/comments, citations extract keys, labels extract names.

byte_start.description: Byte offset of the object's first byte in its source file.

byte_end.description: Byte offset just past the object's last byte.

source_file.description: Snapshot-relative path of the file containing the object.

location.description: Stable source location from parser.py SourceLocation

metadata.description: Parser-specific annotations, e.g. environment name for equations, depth

content_hash.description: SHA-256 of the normalized form. Identity for correspondence tracking, so formatting alone is not read as a substantive change.

parser_source.description: Which extractor found this object, retained so parser bake-off disagreement stays attributable rather than averaged away.

objects.description: Protected objects extracted from the source

parser_name.description: Parser adapter that produced this manifest, e.g. pylatexenc, LaTeXML

parser_version.description: Version string of the parser library

abstentions.description: Constructs the parser could not safely extract

comparison.description: Present when this manifest records a correspondence comparison between a baseline and revised version

baseline_hash.description: Source hash of the baseline (parent) version

revised_hash.description: Source hash of the revised (child) version

object_baseline.description: object_id from baseline manifest, null if this is an added object

object_revised.description: object_id from revised manifest, null if this is a removed object

status.description: Correspondence status per compare.py CorrespondenceStatus enum

confidence.description: Matching confidence 0.0-1.0; below min_confidence threshold produces unresolved

correspondences.description: Matched pairs between baseline and revised, plus unmatched (added/removed)

unresolved_count.description: Count of correspondences with status=unresolved; any nonzero value blocks release per never_except

min_confidence.description: Threshold used to classify low-confidence matches as unresolved
